text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Haahahahaha! I've been waiting for you, 
trainer <username>!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
The look on her face as she takes on the 
final… Mmm! She's practically glowing with 
motivation.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Excellent! Then I have but one thing to 
say.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Believe in the strength of your horse 
girl, and grasp victory together!

The gate to the finals of the URA Finals 
is finally open!
